clips.prompt:
Animate this image as a single continuous shot, no scene cuts: slow push-in toward the bow, waves roll and crash, sea spray glitters, clouds drift, sun rays shimmer, ropes sway gently in the wind. Keep everything else the same. No people, no text, no logos. No dialogue.
(Google Flow · Omni 1.1 Flash · 9:16 · 8s · 720p · 23 Oct 2026)
